author: Isaac Goffin
title: Teen charged after juvenile shot in Center Point - NewsBreak
text:
By Isaac Goffin ,
1 days ago
CENTER POINT, Ala. ( WIAT ) — A juvenile was shot in Center Point on Sunday night.
According to the Jefferson County Sheriff’s Office, deputies responded around 8:57 p.m. Sunday to the 800 block of Farrington Drive regarding a person shot report. Deputies found the juvenile victim.
Center Point Fire District personnel treated the juvenile at the scene. The juvenile was then taken to Children’s of Alabama.
The JCSO stated a preliminary investigation showed the shooting happened after a verbal fight between the victim and the suspect. Deputies obtained details regarding the suspect. Deputies then saw the suspect’s vehicle. The suspect was arrested during a traffic stop.
Jayden Hill, 17, has been charged with first-degree assault. He was released from the Jefferson County Jail after posting bond.
“Great job by our patrol deputies,” Sheriff Mark Pettway said in a statement. “Our citizens stepped up and gave us crucial information that helped to take this armed suspect into custody without anyone else getting hurt. Another wonderful example of how law enforcement and citizens work together towards a common goal.”
Those with information on the shooting are asked to call the JCSO at 205-325-1450 or submit an anonymous tip to Crime Stoppers at 205-254-7777.
